summary.text: Robbie Morris is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 11, listed with Randolph County; the district covers Braxton, Webster, Pocahontas, Randolph, Upshur, Barbour and Pendleton counties. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Government Organization Committee.

paragraphs.text: Morris' page lists a B.A. (2005) and an MBA (2007) from West Virginia Wesleyan College, and his occupation as economic development director.
It names his spouse as Whitney and his children as Elin and Tinley.

His affiliations include the Corridor H Highway Authority, the WV Broadband Enhancement Council, the WV Hardwood Alliance Zone, the WV Economic Development Council, the Southern Economic Development Council and Leadership WV.
Morris is also vice chair of the Economic Development Committee and serves on the Banking and Insurance, Finance, Natural Resources and Transportation and Infrastructure committees.
